summary: SiteDocument represents a document associated with a site in the system, holding identifiers for the document and the site.
purpose: Track and reference documents attached to a site entity.
system_behavior: SiteDocument provides an entity to link documents to sites for further operations.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page class providing administrative welcome information, last login details, and error/warning display panels for staff users.
purpose: Display welcome and status information, facilitate error and warning handling, and allow selection/filtering of data for staff administration.

workflows.name: Page Load and Display
steps: SetupHSPnetPage with user session and display last login.
Initialize site and discipline dropdowns on first load.

conditions: Display panels depending on message visibility.
system_behavior: Displays staff admin welcome info, last login, error and warning panels, and manages filter controls.

summary: ServiceCode is an entity representing a coded service with category, localized descriptions, and ordering for use in multiple parts of the system.
purpose: Provide standardized codes and descriptions for services, including alternate language support.

workflows.name: ServiceCode List Retrieval
steps: Return list of ServiceCode instances, localized as required.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, localized fields are used.
conditions: Use alt fields depending on session language preference.
system_behavior: Provides standardized codes with localization for services.
Supports multiple retrievals by CourseID or TimetableID.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks all actions performed on a site profile, including metadata about changes, users, agency, and phone details.
purpose: Maintain audit history for site profiles, including user actions, fields changed, and associated agency/user information.
business_rules: Use alternate language fields if session language preference is set.
If sysadmin or user ID matches, alternate formatting of user details.
calculations: ActionDateFormatted, AgencyUserFormatted, AgencyUserDetailsFormatted are calculated properties.
system_behavior: Provides audit history of changes to site profiles.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is an entity for tracking and managing files used in email popups, supporting search and deletion operations.
purpose: Allow searching for files associated with popups and deleting individual files or folders.

workflows.name: Search
steps: Split DataInfo, parse entries, return list of EmailPopupDocument.

workflows.name: Delete
steps: Split DataInfo, delete file or folder for given ID, return remaining DataInfo.

system_behavior: Parses delimited strings to extract file info and delete files/folders as required.
Handles errors silently during file/folder deletion.

summary: ExpenseBatch represents a batch of expenses grouped by department, including batch status, description, and key dates. It supports adding, updating, deleting, and searching for batches.
purpose: Track and manage batches of expenses for departments, allowing audit, update, and workflow on expense batches.

workflows.name: Search
steps: Call ExpenseBatchSearch with department ID, return ExpenseBatch list.

workflows.name: Add
steps: Call ExpenseBatchAdd with department, description, and date, return new batch ID.

workflows.name: Update
steps: Call ExpenseBatchUpdate with batch ID, description, date, and status.

workflows.name: Retrieve by ID
steps: Call ExpenseBatchSearchID with batch ID, return ExpenseBatch instance.

business_rules: Use alternate language for status description if session language is set.
Batch is uniquely identified and formatted by combining ID and status.
calculations: BatchNumberFormatted: Combines ID and status description.
conditions: Session language preference controls status description field.
system_behavior: Supports searching, adding, updating, deleting expense batches and formatting batch display.
